title: fix(components,plugin-list): inline edit marks a row modified only on a real change, draws one Actions column, and the Edit inline toggle reports aria-pressed (objectui#11816)
body:
Fixes #11816

Clause-②: no

Grid inline edit, the three defects the card measured on showcase Tasks → *Edit inline*:

## 1. A row is modified only by a real change

**Mechanism (measured).** `data-table`'s `saveEdit` and `stageEdit` staged every committed value into `pendingChanges`. A cell opened and left without a change still commits: a built-in editor commits on blur, and a host-injected editor (the `@object-ui/fields` widget `ObjectGrid` hands in) commits on the document pointerdown listener's click-outside. So "1 row modified · Cancel All · Save All (1)" appeared for a row nobody had changed.

**Fix.** Both staging paths now go through one pure helper, `stageCellChange`. It stages the value only when `isUnchangedCellValue` says it differs from the value the row loaded with. Otherwise it removes the cell's entry, and the row's entry once no cell on it is staged. That last step is what makes staging the loaded value back un-mark the row. The equality rule covers only the round trips the editors make:

- the emptiness floor, `isEmptyValue` from `@object-ui/core` (`null`, `undefined`, `''`, `[]`). `startEdit` seeds a `null` cell's editor with `''`;
- a number against its decimal string. The built-in number editor stores the input's string;
- a multi-value set in another order. `MultiSelectField`'s toggle appends;
- two objects that serialize alike.

Nothing else is equal. The failure direction is asymmetric: calling a change "unchanged" would drop an edit, as `isSameStoredValue` in `@object-ui/plugin-form` also says of its own rule. The ref-based staging is kept as it was: the `editingCellRef` re-entry guard, the `editRevertRef` snapshot, and `stageEdit`'s functional update.

**PM hypothesis partly falsified: "a picklist code against its label".** No producer puts a label in the loaded row. The showcase seeds store codes (`priority: 'high'`). `SingleSelectField` and `MultiSelectField` hand back `option.value`. The select cell renders by resolving the code. The table also holds no options it could map a label through. Equating a label with a code would be a consumer-side tolerance, so it is not implemented.

## 2. One "Actions" column (the choice: a distinct header, not a merge)

**Mechanism (measured).** With inline edit on, `ObjectGrid` draws its own row-menu column (`_actions`, headed by `grid.actions`). It also passes `rowActions: true` to `data-table`, whose trailing column, headed by `common.actions`, only ever holds a modified row's cancel/save pair there. The result is two "Actions" headers. The pin below counts 2 on the base. The second header was a bare string in the cell's larger default type, while every data-column label sits in a `text-xs` muted span.

**Choice: a distinct, consistently styled header.** When the trailing column can only hold that pair, `data-table` heads it with a pencil glyph. The column can only hold the pair when the table is editable, has `onRowSave` or `onBatchSave`, and is given none of the menu inputs `DataTableRowActionsMenu` reads (`onRowEdit`, `onRowDelete`, a non-empty `rowActionDefs` with `onRowActionDef`). The pencil is the one the *Edit inline* toggle carries, with the accessible name and tooltip `table.edit` ("Edit", an existing key in every pack). A column that can hold a row menu keeps "Actions", now in the data-column header type.

Why not merge:

- One column would need `ObjectGrid`'s `_actions` cell to render the table's per-row save/cancel, or the table to render `ObjectGrid`'s `RowActionMenu`. Either needs a new seam: a third `TableColumn.cell` argument, an exported context, or a column-placement key. That is a published-contract change, which the claim's stop conditions route to a re-claim with `Clause-②: yes`.
- A text header would need a new `packages/i18n` key, the other stop condition.
- Dropping the per-row save/cancel pair would remove an existing affordance without a ruling.

## 3. The *Edit inline* toggle reports its state

The toggle is `ListView`'s toolbar button (`data-testid="toolbar-inline-edit-toggle"`) in `@object-ui/plugin-list`, not in `ObjectGrid`. It now sets `aria-pressed` from the inline-edit state. The compact-toolbar entry in `ViewSettingsPopover` is a native checkbox and already exposes its state.

## Files, and the claim's surface

- In the claim: `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, its test `packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-noop-edit-11816.test.tsx`, `.changeset/11816-inline-edit-noop.md`.
- **Outside the claim's list, landed on the producer side as the dispatch directs:** `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (one attribute) and one new case in `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx`. The toggle lives there; `ObjectGrid.tsx` renders no toggle. Also new: `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditNoopAndHeader-11816.test.tsx`, a test only. It drives the real `ObjectGrid` with the real `@object-ui/fields` select, the card's own shape.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is not edited, and nothing in the claim's "Not on it" list is touched.
- No export, prop, type member or `packages/i18n` key is added: `stageCellChange`, `isUnchangedCellValue` and `isSameCellScalar` are module-private.
- Patch changeset for `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-list`. `@object-ui/plugin-grid` gets no entry, because only a test file changed there.

## Gates (final head `4bdd909`, except where a row names `bdbf14a`; `bdbf14a`..`4bdd909` restores one dropped space in `data-table.tsx`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-noop-edit-11816.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditNoopAndHeader-11816.test.tsx packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx` at `4bdd909`: `Test Files  3 passed (3)` · `Tests  160 passed (160)`.

Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` program lists the touched test file (`tsc --listFilesOnly`, one hit each).
- Dependency closure, built first at `bdbf14a`: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build`, exit 0 (`Scope: 14 of 47 workspace projects`).
- The three packages' full suites at `bdbf14a`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/ packages/plugin-list/ packages/plugin-grid/`, giving `Test Files  671 passed | 1 skipped (672)` · `Tests  6740 passed | 24 skipped (6764)`.

- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: `✅  check-control-bytes: OK`.

- `pnpm exec eslint --format json` on the 5 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 5 files, 0 errors. This narrowing is a measurement, for three reasons:
  - its population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` blocks applied to the changed files;
  - `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is per-file and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file;
  - the three modified files carry the same warning counts as at `cef0eee` (34, 188, 26). The two new test files carry `no-explicit-any` warnings, as their siblings do.

**Reverse verification** (one-shot, committed first). `data-table.tsx` and `ListView.tsx` were written back to `cef0eee`. The on-disk markers read `stageCellChange` 0, `rowActionsColumnIsEditOnly` 0 and `aria-pressed={inlineEdit}` 0. The same three test files then ran: `Tests  12 failed | 148 passed (160)`. Every new pin goes red, except the control "a column that can hold a row menu stays Actions", which is green on both trees. The `ObjectGrid` pin reads `expected [ th, th ] to have a length of 1 but got 2`. The files were restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: both blob hashes match `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Tests resolve `@object-ui/*` to `src` (`vitest.config.mts` aliases), so no build sat between the edit and the run.

NOT MEASURED: a real-browser pass on the console against a showcase backend; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` (CI).

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- `onCellChange` still fires on every commit, a no-op commit included. Only the staging is gated, because gating the callback the same way could leave a host that tracked an earlier staged value stale. Carrier: none.
- Two equality rules now exist for "did this value change": `isSameStoredValue` (plugin-form: `''` is not blank, numbers never equal strings) and `isUnchangedCellValue` here. Each matches its own round trip; unifying them is a design question. Carrier: none.
- Read from source, not reproduced: `SingleSelectField`'s cascade clear compares the stored value with option codes exactly, while the select cell resolves a case-variant code. A stored `Referral` against a declared `referral` would be cleared to `null` when the editor mounts, and that is staged, now as a real change. Carrier: none.
- The per-row cancel/save buttons carry English `title` strings ("Cancel changes", "Save row") outside the language packs, unchanged here. Carrier: none.
